_comment: Known cross-edition versification shifts: an EN (KJV/NIV) chapter:verse address that legitimately lands at a DIFFERENT chapter:verse in another language's Bible edition, because that edition splits chapters/verses differently at this point. Each entry means: when validate_translated_pair() can't find the EN-resolved address in the target DB, treat that specific (book, en_reference, target bible_version) combination as an acknowledged exception rather than a fresh warning — the corpus's own stored native reference for this verse has already been verified correct by a human. Add an entry ONLY after confirming the shift directly against the target DB (see shared_validation/scripture_check.py's versification_exceptions module docstring) — never to silence an unrelated or unverified failure.

exceptions.verified: LSG1910 chapter 1 ends at verse 16; the fish-swallows-Jonah verse is chapter 2 verse 1 in this edition.
Same chapter split as LSG1910 — German editions also number this verse as chapter 2 verse 1.
LU17 confirmed text at chapter 3 verse 1 matches KJV Joel 2:28 (Spirit poured out on all flesh).
LU17 confirmed text at chapter 3 verse 23 matches KJV Malachi 4:5 (sending Elijah before the day of the LORD).
